biotools.summary: The Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (KNHANES) Biobank provides access to biospecimens (serum, plasma, DNA, urine) and genotyping data (KoreanChip) for researchers, supporting public health research. The biobank is operated by the National Bank of Korea (NBK) and utilizes the HuBIS_Desk online platform.
